title: New Ask Maps features to help with holiday travel and prep
gist: Google is adding agentic features to Ask Maps: AI-built road-trip itineraries with real-time route data, an agent that finds and calls for local service appointments (U.S. first), and live-availability search of saved lists, while expanding Ask Maps to 30 more European countries for 200+ markets total.

insights.claim: Google's Ask Maps now uses agentic capabilities to find beauty, pet care, auto and home repair appointments online and to call local businesses on the user's behalf, showing open slots across nearby businesses.
insights.speaker: Maz Khorasani
insights.so_what: Maps becoming an agent that books services puts Google directly into the local-services transaction layer, a threat to booking intermediaries and a new monetization lever for Alphabet.
insights.quote: Now, with new agentic capabilities, you can choose to have Ask Maps find beauty, pet care, auto and home repair appointments online and call local businesses for you.
insights.locator: Check off your holiday prep and let Maps find appointments for you

insights.claim: Google Maps' appointment-finding agent and 'Know before you go' route tips launch first in the U.S., with other regions to follow later.
insights.speaker: Maz Khorasani
insights.so_what: Watch the U.S. rollout as the testbed for agentic local commerce before international scaling.
insights.quote: "Know before you go" route tips and finding appointments are launching first in the U.S., with more regions coming soon.
insights.locator: These updates start rolling out today

insights.claim: Ask Maps can generate multi-day road-trip itineraries with a day-by-day schedule, insider tips and numbered map pins, which can be shared or exported to Google Docs on desktop.
insights.speaker: Maz Khorasani
insights.so_what: Cross-product hooks (Maps to Docs) deepen Google ecosystem lock-in and compete with standalone AI travel planners.
insights.locator: Use Ask Maps to plan a day trip

insights.claim: Ask Maps itineraries are live objects: when navigating, users see real-time traffic, opening status and the 'vibe' of the next stop, and can add stops on the fly via conversational prompts.
insights.speaker: Maz Khorasani
insights.so_what: Combining generative planning with Google's proprietary real-time place data is a moat that LLM-only travel assistants cannot easily replicate.
insights.locator: When you’re about to head out

insights.claim: Google Maps directions now surface 'Know before you go' tips covering where to park or charge an EV, plus weather, potential delays and tolls.
insights.speaker: Maz Khorasani
insights.so_what: EV-charging and parking surfacing positions Maps as a gateway for EV infrastructure and parking operators' demand.
insights.locator: Whether you're taking a multi-day road trip

insights.claim: Ask Maps can search a user's saved lists and check live availability, e.g. which saved spots can seat five people within 30 minutes.
insights.speaker: Maz Khorasani
insights.so_what: Live availability queries make Google a front door for restaurant reservations, pressuring reservation platforms.
insights.quote: Which spots saved in my lists have availability for five people in the next 30 minutes?
insights.locator: Show your guests the best spots on your lists

insights.claim: Ask Maps is expanding to 30 European countries including Spain, Germany and the U.K., bringing it to more than 200 countries and territories globally, on Android and iOS.
insights.speaker: Maz Khorasani
insights.so_what: Gemini-powered Maps features reaching 200+ markets gives Google mass distribution for conversational AI, relevant to the AI-assistant share battle and EU regulatory scrutiny.
insights.quote: Ask Maps starts expanding to 30 countries across Europe — including Spain, Germany, and the U.K. — bringing Ask Maps to more than 200 countries and territories globally.
insights.locator: These updates start rolling out today
